senses.definition: A hardwood tree of the genus Juglans.
A nut of the walnut tree.
Dark brown colour, the colour of walnut wood.
Having a dark brown colour, the colour of walnut wood.

quotes.text: A long-skirted, cabalistically-cut coat of a faded walnut tinge enveloped him; the overlapping sleeves of which were rolled up on his wrists.
quotes.reference: 1851, Herman Melville, Moby Dick., archived from the original on 11 Aug 2014:
